notes.title: Introducing: community items!
notes.content: We're pleased to inform you that, among others, you can now get Blind Men trading cards! Thank you for your support, we hope to be able to offer community items for our other games in the near future as well.

notes.title: The Frozen Kingdom is now on Kickstarter
notes.content:
Our next project, a 18+ BL story inspired by 80's fantasy films, is now live on Kickstarter! Essentially, think of it as "What if the adventures of guys like Conan were full of handsome men instead?".

In it, Einar becomes the last barbarian after his village is destroyed by an evil sorcerer. Swearing revenge, he heads on a quest to kill the man... but danger and temptation awaits.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/maneatergames/the-frozen-kingdom-a-sword-and-sorcery-bl-visual-novel?ref=7if3wo]You can support the project here.[/url]

notes.title: Upcoming game release
notes.content:
Our upcoming BL visual novel, Monstrous Lovers, is hitting steam on June 24th! Play as Christopher Wells, a young office worker who moves to a town full of the supernatural and finds himself involved in the lives of four monsters inspired by classic horror movies.

Wishlist it here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1596820/Monstrous_Lovers/

notes.title: Limited physical edition up for pre-order
notes.content:
We've teamed up with Red Art Games to bring you a limited physical edition of Blind Men for PS4! This version includes limited voice overs, and additional german translation, and an all-new cover illustrated by award-nomiated artist Marguerite Sauvage.

This run is limited to 999 copies, so[url=https://www.redartgames.com/accueil/175-blind-men-ps4.html] head over to Red Art Game's website[/url] and get yours before they run out!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/g6pqhaH.png[/img]

notes.title: Blind Men is coming to consoles
notes.content:
Blind Men is coming to consoles courtesy of Ratalaika Games! The game is now available for PS4 & Vita, and will be coming to XboxOne and Switch this April 17. This version will come with an additional language, german, and partial voice acting.
